// Classifier fixture, vitest: OPAQUE helpers and same-file helpers inlined one level, with their
// negatives. Read as text by tests/classify.test.ts.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { expectValidPost } from "./helpers/assertions.js";
import { checkRateLimit } from "../src/rateLimit.js";
import * as helpers from "@test-utils/assertions";

function expectStatus(response, status) {
  expect(response.statusCode).toBe(status);
}

function assertPublished(post) {
  expectStatus(post.response, 201);
}

describe("helpers", () => {
  it("creates a valid post", async () => {
    expectValidPost(await createPost());
  });

  it("creates a post the namespace helper accepts", async () => {
    helpers.expectCreated(await createPost());
  });

  it("limits the rate", () => {
    checkRateLimit(request);
  });

  it("responds with 201", async () => {
    expectStatus(await create(), 201);
  });

  it("publishes the post", async () => {
    assertPublished(await publish());
  });

  it("shows the login form", async () => {
    await authPage.open();
    await authPage.expectLoginFormVisible();
  });
});
